decision: Cleared for bounded integration of the semantic role preservation follow-up. No remaining source finding in this review scope.
source_scope: Only the Ui::move_cell source role reset removal and its native regression are new relative to independently cleared bc99f0ccf90880ef0088357b0a1eedde020bbdaf.
source_reasoning: Ui::move_cell copies both the source cell pixels and CellRoles to the destination. It resets the vacated source glyph and attributes, while explicitly retaining original foreground/background values whenever the reset PaintStyle leaves those channels inherited.

The removed mark(src,None) unconditionally erased semantic origin metadata for those retained pixel channels. Keeping metadata and then applying mark(src,Some(reset)) makes role behavior match the actual pixel patch.

CellRoles::patch preserves existing metadata for an inherited style channel and replaces it for an explicit Set or Reset channel. Role-based resets retain the requested role; raw Color::Reset clears the role. The same mark path works on page and overlay targets.
No new color conversion, style resolver, application painter, control registration or layout/state owner is introduced. The repair does not change alignment geometry or glyph movement.

probe_interpretation_note: An initial new channel probe incorrectly expected reset style to repaint every untouched padding cell. Source CellUi::drop moves only painted source cells, so only vacated source positions receive reset style; untouched slack retains its prior row style. The corrected probe separately compares vacated source position to the explicitly reset reference and untouched slack to the row reference. The original erroneous probe output is preserved at /tmp/right-align-independent-d8dba-channel-probes.log; no repository test or expected baseline artifact was changed.
